visible_objects.description: Compact code panel pinned across the top of the tall frame showing the forward method of the MLP class: def forward, the four forward lines and return x. No line highlighted yet.
visible_objects.label: forward
visible_objects.change: Slides in at the top and settles.

visible_objects.description: A short horizontal bar of cells below the code panel: one token's input vector, n_embd values wide.
visible_objects.label: n_embd
visible_objects.change: Fades in just below the code panel, centred.

beats.transition: Opens on the code panel; the single token bar appears beneath it.
beats.framing: Code panel across the top third; one token bar centred below with empty space beneath for the flow downward.
beats.on_screen_text: Follow one token's vector through forward.
beats.narration_line: Follow one token's vector through forward.

visible_objects.description: Same code panel; the line x = self.c_fc(x) is highlighted as its step runs.
visible_objects.label: forward
visible_objects.change: Highlight lands on the self.c_fc line.

visible_objects.description: Small secondary code strip under the panel showing the __init__ line defining self.c_fc as nn.Linear(config.n_embd, 4 * config.n_embd).
visible_objects.change: Drops in beneath the highlighted forward line.

visible_objects.description: The one token's vector labeled n_embd at its original width.
visible_objects.label: n_embd
visible_objects.change: Stays put but dims as a ghost so the input width remains visible.

visible_objects.description: One token's vector after the c_fc step: the n_embd bar widening into a bar labeled 4 * n_embd that fills the frame's width. Still one bar for one token, not more tokens.
visible_objects.label: 4 * n_embd
visible_objects.change: Grows out of the input bar, stretching outward to full frame width, moving down a row.

must_show_covered: One token's vector labeled n_embd widening to a vector labeled 4 * n_embd at the c_fc step
beats.transition: Focus drops from the highlighted self.c_fc line down to the token bar, which stretches.
beats.framing: Highlighted c_fc line at top; the bar widening to full width is centred; ghost input bar recedes.
beats.on_screen_text: self.c_fc runs first and widens each token's vector from n_embd to 4 * n_embd.
beats.narration_line: c_fc widens one token's vector from n_embd to 4 * n_embd values.

visible_objects.description: Same code panel; highlight moves to x = self.gelu(x).
visible_objects.label: forward
visible_objects.change: Highlight steps down from the c_fc line to the self.gelu line.

visible_objects.description: The c_fc definition strip.
visible_objects.change: Exits upward.

visible_objects.description: The widened vector at the GELU step: values in each cell reshaped one by one, each cell bending in value separately, the bar width staying exactly 4 * n_embd. Cells bend smoothly; none snap flat.
visible_objects.label: 4 * n_embd
visible_objects.change: A sweep passes across the cells; each cell's value bends in turn while the bar's outline width stays fixed.

visible_objects.description: Small tag beside the wide bar naming GELU as a fixed nonlinearity applied per value.
visible_objects.label: fixed nonlinearity
visible_objects.change: Appears next to the bar as the sweep begins.

must_show_covered: Values in the widened vector reshaped one by one at the GELU step, with the width staying 4 * n_embd
beats.transition: Highlight steps down one line; the same wide bar is reshaped in place.
beats.framing: Wide bar centred, filling the width; code panel at top with gelu line lit; ghost input bar faint above.
beats.on_screen_text: self.gelu bends each value separately; the width stays 4 * n_embd.
beats.narration_line: GELU bends each value; it does not change the vector's size.

visible_objects.description: Same code panel; highlight moves to x = self.c_proj(x).
visible_objects.label: forward
visible_objects.change: Highlight steps down to the self.c_proj line.

visible_objects.description: The fixed nonlinearity tag.
visible_objects.label: fixed nonlinearity
visible_objects.change: Fades out.

visible_objects.description: Small code strip showing the __init__ line defining self.c_proj as nn.Linear(4 * config.n_embd, config.n_embd).
visible_objects.change: Drops in beneath the highlighted forward line.

visible_objects.description: The widened 4 * n_embd vector after GELU.
visible_objects.label: 4 * n_embd
visible_objects.change: Stays in place as the source of the combination lines, then dims.

visible_objects.description: Fan of lines: each output cell gathers lines from all of the wide cells, showing a learned combination of every value, not truncation of the extra cells.
visible_objects.label: each output cell gathers all wide cells
visible_objects.change: Lines draw down from every wide cell into each output cell.

visible_objects.description: The widened vector narrowing back to a vector labeled n_embd at the c_proj step, same width as the ghost input bar.
visible_objects.label: n_embd
visible_objects.change: Forms below the wide bar as the lines converge, squeezing to the original width.

must_show_covered: The widened vector narrowing back to a vector labeled n_embd at the c_proj step
beats.transition: Highlight steps down; the wide bar squeezes downward into a narrow bar through converging lines.
beats.framing: Wide bar above, narrow output bar below, lines between them centred; code panel stays at top.
beats.on_screen_text: self.c_proj projects the widened vector back to n_embd values.
beats.narration_line: c_proj projects the widened vector back to n_embd values, a learned combination.

visible_objects.description: Same code panel showing the four forward lines from model.py (self.c_fc, self.gelu, self.c_proj, self.dropout); each has been highlighted in turn as its step runs, and now the self.dropout line is highlighted.
visible_objects.label: forward
visible_objects.change: Highlight steps down to the self.dropout line, completing the sequence.

visible_objects.description: The c_proj definition strip.
visible_objects.change: Exits upward.

visible_objects.description: The fan of combination lines.
visible_objects.label: each output cell gathers all wide cells
visible_objects.change: Fades out.

visible_objects.description: A thin band the output bar passes through, marking dropout as the final pass after c_proj at the same width.
visible_objects.label: final pass
visible_objects.change: Appears and sweeps once over the output bar.

visible_objects.description: The n_embd output bar.
visible_objects.label: n_embd
visible_objects.change: Passes through the dropout band, keeping its n_embd width.

must_show_covered: The four forward lines from model.py (self.c_fc, self.gelu, self.c_proj, self.dropout), each highlighted in turn as its step runs
beats.transition: Highlight takes its last step down; a brief pass sweeps the output bar.
beats.framing: Code panel with dropout line lit at top; output bar centred below; wide bar receded.
beats.on_screen_text: self.dropout runs last; width stays n_embd.

visible_objects.description: Same code panel; highlight spans the self.c_fc, self.gelu and self.c_proj lines together.
visible_objects.label: forward
visible_objects.change: Highlight widens to cover the three lines.

visible_objects.description: The final pass band.
visible_objects.label: final pass
visible_objects.change: Fades out.

visible_objects.description: Several token vectors stacked as rows, each going through the same c_fc → gelu → c_proj path side by side: narrow, widen, bend, narrow, in parallel. No arrows or lines between rows; nothing is exchanged between tokens.
visible_objects.label: c_fc → gelu → c_proj
visible_objects.change: Camera pulls back; the single row multiplies into a short vertical stack and all rows animate the three stages in step.

must_show_covered: Several token vectors going through the same c_fc → gelu → c_proj path side by side without exchanging anything
beats.transition: Pull back from the single bar to reveal a stack of token rows running the same path.
beats.framing: Code panel at top; stack of rows fills the middle, each row isolated with clear gaps between rows.
beats.on_screen_text: The same weights act on every token's vector independently; no information mixes between tokens.
beats.narration_line: The same weights act on each token's vector; tokens do not mix.

visible_objects.description: The stack of token rows.
visible_objects.label: c_fc → gelu → c_proj
visible_objects.change: Collapses back to a single row and fades.

visible_objects.description: The input vector, n_embd wide.
visible_objects.label: n_embd
visible_objects.change: Returns to full brightness on the left.

visible_objects.description: The output vector, n_embd wide; shown together with the input at the end at the same n_embd width.
visible_objects.label: n_embd
visible_objects.change: Slides beside the input bar; their widths visibly match.

must_show_covered: The input and output vectors shown together at the same n_embd width at the end
beats.transition: Stack folds away; input and output bars meet side by side.
beats.framing: Input and output bars side by side at centre with equal width; code panel recedes at top.
beats.on_screen_text: Output keeps the same n_embd width as the input.
beats.narration_line: Same width in, same width out.
